status: Source surveyed and physical design specified. No as-built measurements.

rack.bench_design: Machined rectangular-tooth comb; reference tooth indices and bench survey in physical/RESET.md.
rack.verification_boundary: Specified identical tooth pitch and bearing faces.

locking_tongue.bench_design: 7 × 15 × 3 mm flat load-bearing tongue mounted to a guided yoke.
locking_tongue.verification_boundary: Contact dimensions drawn from USD; capture, bearing clearance and retention need measurement.

brake_tab.bench_design: +X press, 8 mm positive stop; return spring at nominal 0.55 N/mm with 2 mm initial compression.
brake_tab.verification_boundary: Model includes viscous damping. Friction and spring tolerances distinguished in commissioning.

lift.bench_design: Bolt-on neck and stem at the source control position.

carriage.bench_design: Cut a rack clearance lane, add structural bridges and guide hardware; weigh the filled assembly and adjust ballast.
carriage.verification_boundary: Robot-facing grip preserved. Solid backboard and ideal prismatic guide in USD require different internal construction on the bench.

tap.bench_design: Coaxial plug, shaft, 20 mm radius knob, dry detent and hard stops. Register the engraved witness to the wet cartridge.
tap.verification_boundary: Stop angles and grip geometry are specified. Intermediate flow, hysteresis and breakaway torque require physical characterization.

registration.bench_design: Outlet lip and magenta witness on one moving carriage. Green witness fixed to the head platform.
registration.verification_boundary: Survey real wet lip and both sights to a common ruler on each reset.

constant_head.bench_design: Sealed rigid reservoir and vent carried by the independent inert support; restricted FEP path to atmospheric break.
constant_head.verification_boundary: Effective conductance, source stability and wetting are measured on commissioning.

collection.bench_design: Shallow broad receiver weighed below free discharge. Keep a separate air break upstream of the waste route.
collection.verification_boundary: The simulated measuring column is taller than the lowest sill. The physical receiver uses a balance so its level cannot set downstream head.

robot_and_table.bench_design: Stock mounting, independent bracket, dry approach and wet load checks.
robot_and_table.verification_boundary: YAM model hash verified. Kinematic checks and recorded rigid-body contacts cover the simulator.

circuit_integrity.bench_design: Fixed clips, sealed restrictor, independently observed circuit, outcome scored from actual water.
circuit_integrity.verification_boundary: Kinks, leaks and attempts to move a receiver are physical observations. Numerical blocked control disables modeled flow.
